WITH matched_traders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref, t.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind, 
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM matched_traders
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(CAST(count AS NUMERIC)) as avg_count,
    CAST(SUM(count) AS NUMERIC) as total_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.count,
  CAST(tc.count AS NUMERIC) / stats.total_count as ratio,
  CAST(tc.count AS NUMERIC) - stats.avg_count as above_avg
FROM type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats
WHERE CAST(tc.count AS NUMERIC) > stats.avg_count
  AND stats.avg_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tc.tradekind
